name: MsoCTPDockPosition
description: Specifies the docking behavior of the custom task pane.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionLeft
constants.description: Dock the task pane on the left side of the document window.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionTop
constants.description: Dock the task pane at the top of the document window.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionRight
constants.description: Dock the task pane on the right side of the document window.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionBottom
constants.description: Dock the task pane at the bottom of the document window.
